text:
Michael Misa, the second overall pick in 2025, is 19 and growing into the job. He has five goals and 13 points in 25 games at 15 minutes a night, and his ice time is up to more than 16 with Igor Chernyshov out. He scored shorthanded against Seattle on Saturday, part of two quick San Jose goals with Nolan Allen.

The rest is a teenager on a rebuilding team. The Sharks take 40% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and they have scored about 4.4 more goals than those chances with him out there, so the points are running a little ahead of the play. For context: of the 59 forwards picked in the top four from 2005 to 2024, 47 reached 200 NHL games, and the median first full season was 0.56 points a game. Misa scored 62 goals for Saginaw in his draft year. Our range has him around 48 points by April.
